issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

<!-- sentinel: SNTL-TEAL-GODWIT -->

Discuss

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function in the `ExportButton` component sets `busy` to `true` at the start of the export process but only resets it in the `.then()` callback, which only executes if the export succeeds. If the `exportReport` function throws an error (e.g., due to a failed fetch), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button. To fix this, the `.catch()` block should also reset `busy` to `false` to ensure the button is re-enabled after a failed export.
